scenario: quote-confirm-run with quote-bound approval and submitId reuse
description: Confirms that approval is bound to the latest authoritative quote, the submitId is reused on recovery, and per-item batch outcomes are honoured.
expectations: node quote is called against the latest authoritative draft
node confirm mints a short-lived creditConfirmationToken and refuses when --credit-ceiling is below the latest total
node run is called with the same submitId across retries; switching submitId re-bills
Batch node run supplies one submitId per nodeId with equal length and order, and persists the ordered mapping before submission
node run per-item outcomes map to the documented exit codes (0, 2 REJECTED, 20 UNKNOWN/resume)
A missing submission.state is treated as 'accepted', not 'absent'
REJECTED is terminal and is never auto-retried
Failures are branched on exit code + requiredAction, never on localized message
